caveats: These are hand-checked news reports of incidents across the map's streams, not statistics. They are not complete and not representative of everything that happens in any area.
Most rows rest on a single report or on police statements repeated by several outlets; see reporting_independence.
Map points are approximate. uncertainty_m says how far off a point can be, and location_basis says when a point is inferred or estimated rather than reported.
Reports can be wrong or change after publication. Check the source links before relying on any row.

fields.name: signal_id
fields.help: FORGE's ID for the pin.

fields.name: short_id
fields.help: First 8 characters of the ID, as used in map links.

fields.name: title
fields.help: The pin's title on the map.

fields.name: province
fields.help: Province of the batch the pin was published in.

fields.name: stream
fields.help: The map stream the pin is filed under, as named in the map's Streams panel: Crime & Security, Infrastructure, Priority Intelligence or Africa & World.

fields.name: incident_start
fields.help: When the incident happened or began, as best the reports allow (ISO 8601).

fields.name: incident_precision
fields.help: How exact incident_start is: time, approx_time, part_of_day or day.

fields.name: incident_event
fields.help: occurred = when it happened; found = when a body was found.

fields.name: incident_date_basis
fields.help: What incident_start stands for. incident = when it happened or began (or was found); report = the sources never say when it happened, so it is the report or notice date; later_step = an arrest, charge or court date in an older case, whose earlier date is in incident_described.

fields.name: incident_described
fields.help: The incident time in words, with who gave it.

fields.name: reported_at
fields.help: Date of the earliest report found (not proven to be the first).

fields.name: location_described
fields.help: Where the reports place it, and what the map point marks.

fields.name: latitude
fields.help: Map point latitude, rounded to 5 decimals. Not an exact scene.

fields.name: longitude
fields.help: Map point longitude, rounded to 5 decimals. Not an exact scene.

fields.name: map_precision
fields.help: What the map point stands for: spot, street, area, suburb, village, town, farm or precinct (an estimate for the police area only).

fields.name: uncertainty_m
fields.help: How far, at most, the real place can plausibly be from the point, in metres.

fields.name: location_basis
fields.help: reported = the reports name this place; inferred = FORGE's reading of a place the reports do not pin down; estimated = the place could not be mapped, so the point stands for the police area that handled the case.

fields.name: reporting_independence
fields.help: Whether the reports are independent of each other (most are not).

fields.name: statement_from
fields.help: Who the reporting rests on, usually police.

fields.name: outlets
fields.help: News outlets that reported it, separated by ' | '.

fields.name: source_urls
fields.help: Source article links, separated by ' | '.

fields.name: source_count
fields.help: Number of source articles linked.

fields.name: archived_source_count
fields.help: How many of those links have a saved archive copy.

fields.name: fact_conflict_count
fields.help: Facts on which the reports disagree.

fields.name: fact_audit
fields.help: Whether the pin's key facts were checked claim by claim against the sources.

fields.name: approval_id
fields.help: The owner approval record this row matches.

fields.name: pin_version
fields.help: Version of the pin's approved data.

fields.name: approved_at
fields.help: When that approval was given.

fields.name: published_at
fields.help: When the pin went on the map.

fields.name: map_link
fields.help: The pin on the map (relative to the site).

fields.name: data_version
fields.help: Git commit of the pin and approval files this export was built from.

records.title: Beitbridge border post (approx.): North West businessman charged 21 Oct as co-accused over two Absa-financed cars intercepted in Jul
